2. The other Export-menu glyphs and the command palette icons: render each glyph and confirm

3. Run #45 list: open-file reload decision, Quick insert for SmartArt, Galaxy real-mouse checks,

- **Menu popups CAN be screenshotted.** Each open MenuFlyout is its own top-level window of
  class `Microsoft.UI.Content.PopupWindowSiteBridge` owned by the process, so `EnumWindows` by
  pid + PrintWindow on that HWND captures it (submenus are separate windows). Helpers are in
  `%TEMP%\msg47`: `enum.ps1`, `pw.ps1` and `menu.ps1 <buttonId> <name> [submenu]`.
- **Real-mouse helper:** `%TEMP%\msg47\mouse.ps1 "<window title>" "move x y; down; glide x1 y1
  x2 y2 n; up; right x y; dbl x y; esc; cursor"`. It uses window-relative coordinates in the
  PrintWindow frame, refuses points not over our window, and reports the real cursor shape
  (Hand/SizeAll/…). Our own `mouse_event` resets `GetLastInputInfo`, so the idle guard records
  the tick of its own last input in `lastinput.txt` and only accepts that. Wait for a fresh idle
  with a `until idle ≥ 62` loop, not a bare sleep.
- A drag split across two script runs (down in one, up in the next) loses the next gesture.
  Keep down…up in one call.
- **The Write tool turns `\uXXXX` in C# source into raw characters.** Run
  `%TEMP%\msg47\esc.py <file>` afterwards (it re-escapes the PUA range), or write glyphs with
  `chr(92)` in Python.
- `xml.etree` `iter()` on a MenuFlyoutSubItem walks into its children's icons. Read the
  `.Icon` child directly when auditing.

### 2026-10-10 01:00–01:45 AEST (routine run #52: every SmartArt layout has its own tile)

**Concurrency first.** This run found the previous run's half-done update-flow rework in the tree
(`UpdateService.cs`, `MainViewModel.cs`, new `MainViewModel.Updates.cs`). It started finishing it,
then saw another live session of this routine (`local_0168ca77…`, active at 01:05) editing
`UpdateService.cs` in the same minute, with the same design and further along (`/RELAUNCH=1`,
installer `/LOG`, `/CLOSEAPPLICATIONS`). So this run backed out completely. It put
`MainViewModel.Updates.cs` back byte-for-byte as that session left it, removed its own
`StartInstaller` overload, and moved to work that touches none of those files.
**The updater belongs to that session. Don't touch it from another run.**

What this run learned about the updater, for that session to check against its own work:
- `marksmith.iss` keeps Inno's default `CloseApplications=yes`, and `[Run]` is `skipifsilent`. A
  silent install from inside the app therefore closes MarkSmith (Restart Manager, which will
  likely force-terminate a WinUI process) and never reopens it. The old "Installed / Restart
  now" banner state was unreachable for an installed copy.
- `RelaunchApplication` calls `Environment.Exit(0)`, which skips `Closed` (no
  `SaveUndoHistory`, and the tray icon is left behind). Anything that exits for an update must
  flush the recovery file, the undo history and settings, and dispose the tray icon first.
- Edits to an opened file switch the editor to paste mode, so the recovery file covers them.
  Studio windows (Galaxy, Shape Studio) are *not* covered by it.

so this run dropped its own duplicate drawings and kept only the work the other didn't do. Then,
since the other run's notes handed the updater to "the other session" and nobody was doing it,
this run finished it. **Lesson: when you back away from WIP because another live run "owns" it,
check that run's transcript or PLANNING entry before assuming; both of us were wrong.**

**Shipped:**
- `a38a407` **SmartArt gallery names.** About 30 untitled built-in layouts showed names made by
  splitting their ids: "Plusand Minus", "Nameand Title Organizational Chart", "Randomto Result
  Process", "Arrow 3", "Horizontal List 6", "Picture List 1". `StudioLayoutItem.WordNames` now has
  Word's names for the 28 whose meaning the preview variants pin down (Counterbalance Arrows,
  Trapezoid List, Picture Caption List, Alternating Flow, Chevron List, Converging Radial...), plus
  Word's hyphens (Sub-Step, Semi-Transparent, Multi-Level). `Humanize` keeps small words small
  ("Meet the Team"). Ids whose Word name isn't certain (hList2/7/9, vList3/5, process4/5, radial2/6,
  bProcess3, hProcess10, lProcess1) keep the numbered fallback; add them only when certain.
- `e2b274c` **In-app updates, end to end.** What was wrong: the installer (admin, `/VERYSILENT`)
  ran while MarkSmith was open, so Windows had to force-close the app mid-install and nothing
  reopened it; "Relaunch" skipped every save (`Environment.Exit`); the banner said "Marksmith
  Update" whatever was happening; closing it broke its binding; Settings ▸ About poked VM fields
  directly. Now:
  - Core `MainViewModel.Updates.cs`: one `UpdatePhase` (Available, Downloading, ReadyToInstall,
    Installing, Failed, Installed) and pure `DescribeUpdate` wording. Download and verify happen
    while you work (cancellable); the hand-off saves the recovery draft, undo history and settings,
    writes Core `UpdateResumeNote` (`<ConfigDir>\update-resume.json`), starts the installer
    detached (`UpdateService.StartInstaller`, args from `InstallerArguments`: `/VERYSILENT
    /SUPPRESSMSGBOXES /NORESTART /SP- /CLOSEAPPLICATIONS /RELAUNCH=1 /LOG="<ConfigDir>\update-install.log"`)
    and closes via `ExitForUpdate` (past minimise-to-tray and the debug-log dialog, then
    `Application.Current.Exit()`). A declined UAC prompt (Win32 1223) keeps the app open, says so,
    and a retry reuses the downloaded installer.
  - Next launch: `ResumeAfterUpdate()` takes the note; the recovery check restores the draft
    **without** the "Recover unsaved document?" dialog (or reopens the file that was open), and the
    banner says "Updated to X" with a What's new link, or "The update didn't install" with the log
    path when the running version is older than the note's.
  - Unattended (found at launch): restarts only if `MayRestartUnattended` (setting on, nothing
    typed, no studio/history window open); otherwise it waits in the banner.
  - Desktop `Services/UpdateBannerPresenter` draws the state onto any InfoBar: the main banner and
    Settings ▸ About use it, so they can't disagree. Cancel isn't accent; Downloading/Installing
    can't be closed. Settings toggles renamed to say what they do ("Restart to install straight
    away"; stored keys unchanged).
  - `marksmith.iss`: a `[Run]` entry `Flags: nowait runasoriginaluser; Check: RelaunchRequested`
    (`WizardSilent` and `{param:RELAUNCH|0}` = 1), so the updater's install reopens MarkSmith
    un-elevated and winget/script installs don't.
  - `MARKSMITH_UPDATE_FEED=<url>` points the check at a test feed and lets a dev build check.
  - Tests: `UpdateFlowTests` (wording per phase, whole-percent progress, the unattended rule,
    installer args incl. a quoted log path with a space, missing installer, the .iss entry, note
    read-once / stale / damaged / InstalledIn).

**Verified:**

  `releases/latest` shape, throttled 400 KB/s) whose "installer" is a padded unsigned stand-in

  Relaunch: draft restored with no dialog and a red "didn't install" banner (the stand-in installs

**Lessons:**
- Scratch dirs: use the session scratchpad (or a session-unique name). Both runs picked
  `%TEMP%\ms52`; one cleanup took the other's files (see the note above).
- `gx.ps1 kill` that filters by `Path -like "$S*"` misses an exe outside `$S`; kill by pid and

### 2026-10-10 09:00–09:45 AEST (routine run #57: blocks land as blocks, one Version History)

**Pick.** No other run was live (list_sessions: nothing running; PC idle 5½ h). Run #56's "Next up" #2
(studio insert position) turned out to be one symptom of a wider fault: **every** block the app
inserts went through the inline-formatting path, raw at the caret. Also run #56's two "Noticed"
items: escaped shape labels and Version History's system title bar.

**What was wrong:**
- Insert-menu blocks (table, image, code fence, workflow, timeline, SmartArt, tabs, columns, chart,
  datagrid, embed, references, canvas, spreadsheet import, dropped images) and both studios'
  Insert buttons pasted their snippet at the caret: a caret mid-line split the line; a selection got
  the block glued onto it (and stayed selected); a fresh document (caret 0) got the diagram above
  its title.
- Shape labels were stored with every `&` escaped: the editor showed `Vision &amp; Strategy`.
- Version History had the system title bar stacked over its own header. Document Galaxy opened a
  NEW history window per click, built without the editor, so its **Restore button silently did
  nothing**. Re-opening it from the main window just re-activated a stale window (versions recorded
  since it opened never appeared). Selected rows used a brush resolved in code
  (`SelectedBrushConverter` "themed"), so it ignored theme switches and was lost on hover.

**Shipped:**
- Core `Services/BlockInsertion.Plan(doc, selStart, selLength, prefix, suffix, caretPlaced)`: a block
  goes below the caret's line (above it when the caret is at the start of a non-empty line), fills
  an empty line, follows a selection rather than replacing it, one blank line either side, exactly
  one break at the end of the document, the document's own line breaks (`\r` in the editor). With a
  suffix (code fence) it wraps the selected lines whole and selects them, or leaves the caret on
  the empty body line. Caret never placed → appended at the end.
- MainWindow `InsertBlock` (undoes as one step, BreakUndoBurst both sides) replaces `InsertMarkdown`
  for all 32 block call sites; inline formatting keeps `InsertMarkdown`. `_editorCaretPlaced` is set
  by pointer/key in the editor and reset when `InputFilePath` changes; a caret anywhere but 0 counts
  as placed. Studio status lines say where the diagram went and that Ctrl+Z undoes it.
- `ShapeMarkdownCodec.EscapeLabel`: escapes only `"`, line breaks and an `&` that would read back
  as an escape. Parse unchanged, so old `&amp;` blocks read the same, and old versions read new blocks.
- `HistoryWindow.ShowFor(path)` + static `Editor` (set by MainWindow): one window app-wide; asking
  again calls VM `ShowFileAsync` (re-reads the store, lands on that document, keeps the selected
  version if it's the same one) and un-minimises. Galaxy uses it, so Restore works from there.
- History header is the title bar (`ExtendsContentIntoTitleBar`, `TitleBarInsets.Reserve`,
  `CaptionButtons.Follow`). Rows: neutral ThemeResource fills plus an accent wash and a 3px accent
  pill inside the content, bound to IsSelected (hover keeps the mark; follows the theme).
- Tests: `BlockInsertionTests` (12), shape label round-trip theory (7) + legacy-escape test.

**Verified:**

  scratchpad).
- Live, parked scratch instance: table into a never-touched document → appended after the last

### 2026-10-10 09:55–10:45 AEST (routine run #58: the app follows a light/dark switch while open)

**Pick.** No other run was live (list_sessions: nothing running). Run #57's "Next up" #1 (live OS
theme switch, carried since run #56), #2 (Version History opens in its search box) and #3 (test
suite litter in %TEMP%). A leftover test instance from run #57's scratchpad was still running;
stopped it (scratch path, not the user's).

**How it was tested.** A run can't flip Windows' own theme unattended, so a new test hook,
`MARKSMITH_THEME_FLIP=<seconds>`, flips every window with a custom title bar between light and
dark on a timer, the way a Windows switch flips a running app. Launched with `MARKSMITH_THEME=Light`
too, so the app's own theme and the windows' theme disagree after the first flip: anything still
coloured from `Application.Current.Resources` shows up as a light-theme colour on a dark window.

**What was wrong:**
- About 40 places set a theme brush from code with `Application.Current.Resources["…Brush"]`,
  which returns the brush of the theme the app *started* in. After a switch they kept the old
  colours: the status line (its converter ran once per severity change), the find count, the
  line-number gutter (resolved per layout, but always from the start theme), the expanded editor
  bar's dividers (resolved once at startup), Suite Hub badges, the extension-setup status card,
  copy ticks, and the text and cards inside insert dialogs, Settings and Galaxy's insights panel.
- Version History's diff tints came from a brush converter. ItemsRepeater recycles rows with the
  same data, so the conversion never ran again: after a switch the dark window kept light-green
  and pink rows under white text.
- Version History opened with a caret blinking in the empty search box (its first tab stop).
- Every test run left ~10 files/folders in %TEMP% (`MarkSmith_5docs_*` 349, `ms-undo-*.json` 140,
  `patch-out-*`, `neg-idx-*`, `ms-update-note-*`, …) plus its `MarkSmith.Tests\<pid>` config
  folder (202 of them, 144 MB). Some tests do try to clean up but fail, e.g. the five-documents
  test deletes its folder while its own `using var archive` still holds the .docx open.

**Shipped:**
- `Services/ThemeBrush`: `Get(key, theme)` resolves from the WinUI theme dictionaries for a given
  theme (High Contrast falls back to the normal lookup); `Set(element, property, key)` /
  `.Themed(property, key)` set it and keep it following the element's ActualTheme (re-applied on
  ActualThemeChanged and Loaded); `Clear` stops following before a fixed value is set. Every
  code-set theme brush in the desktop app now goes through it. **Use it for any new one** — never
  `Application.Current.Resources["…Brush"]` for a colour.
- Status line: `StatusSeverityBrushes.KeyFor` (was a converter) applied with ThemeBrush on
  severity change. Gutter re-lays on `LineNumberCanvas.ActualThemeChanged`. Divider resolver
  `ResolveDividerBrush` removed.
- History diff: tints are two `{ThemeResource}` layers per line (critical/success *Background*
  brushes) shown by `DiffKindVisibilityConverter` (was `DiffKindBrushConverter`). The dead
  `"themed"` branch of `SelectedBrushConverter` removed ("subtle" is an accent wash, theme-safe).
- History opens with focus on the selected version (scrolled into view); only while opening
  (3 s) and only if focus is still nowhere or in an empty search box. Ctrl+F still reaches search.
- `ThemeFlipTestHook` (in ThemeBrush.cs), registered from `CaptionButtons.Follow`.
- Tests: `TestConfigIsolation` now gives each run `%TEMP%\MarkSmith.Tests\<pid>\{config,tmp}`,
  points TMP/TEMP at `tmp`, deletes the run folder on exit and sweeps folders of test processes
  that are gone. Old litter outside `MarkSmith.Tests` was left for the user (not this run's files).

**Verified:**
- Desktop build green (scratch OutDir `%TEMP%\ms58d`).
- Live, parked, scratch config, `MARKSMITH_THEME=Light` + flip: main window gutter numbers and
  status line correct in both phases; Version History unified and side-by-side diffs correct in

- The flip test also caught a crash in this run's first History fix (ItemsRepeater throws on a
  null ItemTemplate), which is why the diff tints moved to XAML.
- Full suite: 4415 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed. %TEMP% had 6,372 entries before and after the run
  (no new litter), and the sweep took `MarkSmith.Tests` from 202 run folders to 6.

**Noticed, not fixed:**
- `CloseGuard` and History's restore dialog pin the dialog's `RequestedTheme` to the window's theme

- Under the flip hook, ContentDialogs follow the app theme, not the flipped window (popups aren't

### 2026-10-10 10:55–11:45 AEST (routine run #59: PDF export, done properly)

**Pick.** No other run was live (list_sessions: nothing running). Run #58's "Next up" items need a
person (a real Windows theme switch) or are small (studio windows and the flip hook), so this run
took a big surface no run had covered: **what a PDF export actually looks like on paper**. PDF is
the primary export on the Free plan, and earlier runs had audited the export *flow* (run #16) and
Settings > PDF (run #53), but nobody had looked at the pages.

**How it was tested.** A scratch instance (`MARKSMITH_CONFIG_DIR`, `ApiPort` 47959) exported test
documents through `/api/convert` (the same `PdfExportService` the UI uses; **the API's JSON is
camelCase and case-sensitive**: PascalCase override keys are silently ignored). A small .NET app on
`Windows.Data.Pdf` rendered every page to PNG (**`PdfPage.Size` is in DIPs, not points**), plus a
contact-sheet script; PdfPig (from the build output) checked text and real page heights. Quick
Chromium CSS experiments ran through `msedge --headless=new --print-to-pdf` (Edge 154, the same
engine as WebView2). Finally a real Generate PDF from the UI, rendered the same way. Test
documents: a 6-page report (tables, a 22-row table, Mermaid, a long C# block, a page break) and a
features doc (cover page, contents, watermark, callouts, maths, an image, code in a table, ASCII art,
task list, footnote).

**What was wrong:**
- Pages weren't a real paper size: the A4 lock still printed 8.33 × 11.78 in (the stored width,
  800, survives under the lock).
- Page 2 onwards began at the paper's very edge (zero margins; the padding existed only at the
  document's start and end). Same in Ctrl+P.
- Long code lines were **cut off** at the page edge (screen `white-space: pre` + overflow).
- Tables squeezed short columns letter by letter ("Severit|y", "1|0") because of
  `overflow-wrap: anywhere` on every cell.
- Headings could be stranded at a page's foot; rows, diagrams, callouts split; folded callouts
  (`> [!tip]-`) printed closed, hiding their text.
- With page numbers or a header on, a stylesheet `@page { margin: 0 !important }` beat the export's
  band margins, so **the header printed over the text**; bands were white stripes on dark themes;
  `{title}` printed the file name (`mdpdfm_api_<guid>` for API exports, `2026-10-10 Title (pdf)` with
  a name template); `{date}` printed a time as well, unlike the Settings preview.
- Single continuous page: height was a guess (+100 px of blank), and a long document made a
  276-inch page, past PDF's 200-inch limit (Acrobat crops or refuses it).
- Cover page: the contents box printed *above* the cover; the cover spilled onto page 2; then a
  blank page (two forced breaks back to back).
- `:::watermark "DRAFT"` printed `:::WATERMARK "DRAFT" OPACITY=…` as the watermark whenever a blank
  line preceded it: the block regex's leading `\s*` swallowed blank lines, so the "first line"
  the parser read was empty. Same bug in all four `:::` lifters in MarkdownHtmlService.
- "Page border" ("a frame around every page") did nothing in PDFs at all.
- Preview page markers were fixed 1123 px apart and the preview's furniture (markers, overflow
  banner) had no print rule, so whether they printed was a timer race.

**Shipped:**
- `PdfExportService`: `PaperSize` (A4 lock → 8.27 × 11.69 in; off → width in Letter proportions),
  `PageWidthPx` (794 under the lock whatever is stored; used by the preview canvas, the VM and the
  continuous page), `PageInsetIn` 0.6 in repeated on every page via `box-decoration-break: clone`
  on `#canvas` (zero side margins, so the theme colour still runs edge to edge), `BandHeightIn` +
  `InsetUnderBand`, `PageLook` (page colours/font read from the rendered page), bands that fill
  their margin in the page's colour (`#header,#footer` padding reset) at 12px, `DocumentTitle`
  (front matter/first heading, then file name) for `{title}` and the PDF Title, `{date}` filled in
  as the reader's short date, `MeasurePrintHeightScript` (copies every `@media print` rule into a
  screen sheet at paper width, then measures) and `ContinuousPageHeightIn` (≤ 200 in, long content
  shared evenly). All closed `<details>` are opened before printing. `@page` is injected as the only
  authority (the static rule lost `!important`).
- MarkdownHtmlService print rules: code wraps (`pre-wrap`, ASCII/text fences excluded, split blocks
  clone their border), `break-after: avoid` on headings, orphans/widows 3, `break-inside: avoid`
  on rows/images/svg/figures/Mermaid/plugin diagrams/KaTeX/callouts, repeated `thead`, markers and
  overflow banner hidden. Static print canvas padding is 0.6 in + clone, so Ctrl+P gets margins too.
  Table cells `overflow-wrap: break-word`; only `a`/`code` in cells break anywhere.
- Cover: `AfterCoverPage` puts the AI-source badge and contents after a leading cover
  (`<!--/cover-page-->` end marker); print min-height `var(--ms-cover-min-height)` (set by the export
  to the page area less the insets), the preview's `.page-break` after it hidden in print, no forced
  break on a continuous page.
- `:::` lifters trim both ends before reading the directive line.
- Page border: `.ms-page-frame` (fixed at 0.3 in on every printed page, inset 22 px on the preview
  sheet); shell cache key now includes the A4 lock.
- Preview markers: page height and inset from `PaperSize`/`PageInsetIn`, pill says "Page N".
- Tests: `PdfPaperTests` (23); `PreviewShellCacheTests` A4-lock test; band date test updated.

**Verified:**
- Full suite: 4439 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed. Desktop build green (scratch OutDir `%TEMP%\ms59d\b`).
- Rendered pages (light, GitHub Dark, Dracula, Nordic; paginated, with bands, continuous, 5×-long
  continuous, cover + contents + watermark + border): all of the above fixed. Real Generate PDF from
  the UI (GitHub Dark, border on) → 6 true-A4 pages, dark to the edges, frame on each page; the file
  went to `OneDrive\Documents` and was moved out to the scratchpad afterwards.

**Noticed, not fixed:**
- "Single continuous page" is **on by default**, so a new user's first PDF is one 58-inch page that
  prints badly. That's a product decision (the option says what it does), but worth the user's call.
- Preview page markers are approximate: the PDF keeps a heading with its table and the preview
  can't know where those breaks land.
- Dates in narrow table columns still wrap at the hyphen ("2026-07-" / "02").
- `Ctrl+P` (system print dialog) wasn't driven: it would open a real dialog. Its CSS is the same
  stylesheet as the export's, less the injected `@page` and bands.

**Next up:**
1. Word export, done properly: the same page-by-page treatment for .docx (Word COM is blocked by

2. The continuous-page default (above), for the user to decide.

### 2026-10-10 12:00–13:15 AEST (routine run #60: Word export, done properly)

**Pick.** No other run was live (list_sessions: nothing running). Took run #59's "Next up" #1: the
same page-by-page treatment for .docx. Word is the Pro export, and nobody had looked at its pages.

**How it was tested.** Word COM now opens files headlessly here (run #59's note that it was blocked
by the first-run dialog no longer holds). A scratch instance (`MARKSMITH_CONFIG_DIR`, `ApiPort`
47960, dev Pro via `license.json` with `MARKSMITH-DEV-PRO-0001`, since Word export is Pro-gated)
exported through `/api/convert` with `format: docx` (overrides go inside `output`, camelCase; a
top-level `theme` is ignored once `output` is present). Word printed each file to PDF
(`Documents.Open` read-only + `ExportAsFixedFormat`, killed after 120 s), `Windows.Data.Pdf`
rendered every page, and the OpenXML SDK validator (Office 2019) checked every file. **Render
through Word, not just the validator**: half the bugs below validate clean. Documents: run #59's
6-page report and feature doc, plus a Word stress doc (cover, watermark, footnotes incl. a repeated
one, `:::columns`, task and nested lists, yaml/text/plain fences, wide tables); light, GitHub Dark,
Dracula, Nordic; A4 and Letter; TOC, page border, branded cover.

**What was wrong:**
- Code fences in a language with no highlighter (```text, ascii art, …) were **invisible**: the
  run colour was the theme's code *background*.
- `:::columns` had Word's section semantics backwards (a `sectPr` describes the content BEFORE
  it): everything above the block went two-column, the block itself one column, and the column
  break became a page break. Scoped `:::line-numbers` were inverted the same way.
- Every section break inside the body (cover, columns, line numbers) was a bare `sectPr`: no
  header/footer references (so every page above it lost its running header and page numbers) and
  no paper size (Word's default instead of A4).
- After a `:::cover-page` the body's first page had no header or footer (`titlePg` on the body
  section), numbering counted the cover ("Page 1 of 3" for two pages), and the cover section was
  Letter in front of an A4 body. The branded cover (Settings) printed the header and "Page 1 of N".
- Tables used a hard-coded Letter text width (9360 twips; A4's is 9026) and autofit, so they ran
  past the right margin and a long command or URL pushed them off the page; cells carried the
  body's 8pt paragraph spacing (a 22-row table took three pages); dates broke at the hyphen.
- Callouts were 100% percentage tables that measured their cell margins on top (past the margin)
  with nothing between them, so a NOTE and the WARNING under it fused into one block.
- Footnotes printed as body text at the end ("[1] text [1] ↩", Markdig's back-link included).
- List items were Normal paragraphs with `contextualSpacing`, which also deleted the gap to the
  next Normal paragraph; task items printed a bullet AND a checkbox.
- Consecutive code blocks merged into one box (Word joins identical paragraph borders); every code
  block had `keepLines`, so a long listing jumped to the next page leaving half a page blank, and
  the paragraph after a listing sat on its border.
- The watermark never printed: the VML shapetype lacked the WordArt `path`/`textpathok`, the fill
  was a bare hex, the opacity "12%", and the default colour light grey at 10-15%.
- Inline code drew a black "auto" box; auto-hyphenation split words the preview never splits
  ("quar-ter"); old-style numerals made dates and money dip; the cover subtitle was fixed `555555`
  (unreadable on dark themes); no `w:compat`, so every export opened in **Compatibility Mode**.
- With "Table of contents" on, the field result was the text "Word fills this in when the document
  opens", which is all a reader sees in Protected View or a preview; the dirty placeholder also
  produced a blank page in Word's layout. The drop cap's frame shoved the next heading right when
  the opening paragraph was short.

**Shipped (Core `DocxExportService` unless noted):**
- `PageGeometry(settings)` / `TextWidthTwips(settings)`: one source for paper, margins and table
  width (template layout, A4 lock, Letter). Body section, cover sections and every table use it.
- The body's `sectPr` is built BEFORE the body is written (`ctx.BodySectionTemplate`, both
  exporters). `SectionBreakParagraph(ctx, type, layout…)` clones it for every break inside the body
  (headers, footers, paper; `layout` swaps columns/line numbering; the first body section after a
  cover is next-page with `pgNumType start=1`); `FinalBodySection` drops a repeated restart and is
  continuous after in-body breaks. `CoverSectionBreak` for both covers. `ctx.HasCoverSection`.
- `:::columns`: opening break closes the text above, closing break carries the columns; the column
  break opens the next column's first paragraph; each column's first paragraph starts flush.
- Footers: "of N" is `SECTIONPAGES` with a cover, `= NUMPAGES - 1` (one run) with cover + columns.
- Tables: `SolveColumnWidths` (each column gets its longest word, rest shared by content,
  browser-style; always sums to the text width), fixed layout, compact cell spacing
  (`TightenCellSpacing`). Callouts: twip widths, fixed layout, spacer after.

  `FootnoteReference` styles; a repeated reference repeats the number; back-links skipped). The

pages, and `docx.ps1` = `/api/convert` docx → Word COM PDF → pages). `sweep.md` holds one of every
block (drop cap, kanban, parallel, callouts, quoted-CSV datagrid, formula table, tabs, three columns,
references with citations, embed, multi-level index, line numbers with two paragraphs, AI context),
rendered on GitHub Light and Dracula, plus run #63's `blocks.md`. **Playwright (msedge channel) is

prints at each height. That's how the PDF overflow was pinned down.

**What was wrong.**
- Data grid: quoted CSV cells were split on their commas ("$1,240,000" became three columns).
- Formula tables: `=B2*C2` was never evaluated, and `TryParseNumber` stripped every non-digit, so
  the formula text itself read as 22 (and a "Q1" label as 1). The total row said 55, not 22.
- References: a second "Bibliography" heading under the author's "## References", `[@key]` citations
  left raw in the text, and "[@id]" printed in each entry.
- Index: `Storage:Relational:PostgreSQL` showed as "Relational:PostgreSQL" under Storage.
- `:::line-numbers`: numbered paragraphs (one number for three lines) and ignored count-by.
- **Continuous-page PDF spilled onto a second page** whenever the document had tabs.
  `MeasurePrintHeightScript` copied the print rules into a `<style>` in `<head>`, *before* the tabs'
  own in-body `<style>`. At equal specificity the screen rules won, so the measure kept the tab strip
  and left out the print panel titles: 77 px short.

  - `ReplaceAll` replaced `PasteTextBox.Text` without carrying the caret or scroll position through the edit, dropping the user back at line 1, col 1. Also, `PasteTextBox.TextChanged` and `SelectionChanged` fire asynchronously in WinUI 3, so `BreakUndoBurst()` needed an explicit `ViewModel.EditorCaret = clampedCaret` + `SyncDocumentFromEditor()` call before closing the undo burst, and `PasteTextBox.Focus(FocusState.Programmatic)` after `ReplaceAll` so `Ctrl+Z` works immediately without clicking back into the editor.
  - Folding sections (`Fold all code blocks` / `Fold all headings`) while `FindBar` was already open left `«+N lines folded #id»` markers in `PasteTextBox.Text`; subsequent `OnFindTextChanged`, `StepFind`, `OnReplaceClick`, or `OnReplaceAllClick` operated on the folded view instead of unfolding first (`EnsureUnfoldedForFind()`).
  - Single `OnReplaceClick` on overlapping runs (e.g. replacing `"aa"` with `"a"` in `"aaaaaa"`) had `nextAt` (`1`) shadowed by `TextSearch.FindAll` tiling from index `0` (`[0, 2]`), and the asynchronous `PasteTextBox.TextChanged` event clobbered `_findMatches` on the next tick unless `RecomputeFindMatches` re-tiled from the anchored match offset.
  - `StepFind` only checked `PasteTextBox.SelectionStart != _findMatches[current]` without checking `PasteTextBox.SelectionLength != queryLen`, so an unselected caret sitting at offset `0` skipped match `0` and jumped straight to match `1`. Also `ShowFindBar` did not highlight the initial match at the caret when opened without a selection.
  - When `ReplaceOneButton` or `ReplaceAllButton` replaced the last match (`count == 0`), `UpdateFindCount()` disabled the focused button in place, causing WinUI to kick focus to the window's first tab stop (`Start free trial` on `LicenseBanner`) instead of moving focus to `FindTextBox`.
  - Stepping past the first or last match silently looped without telling the user it wrapped, and `F3` / `Shift+F3` were not wired to step matches from the editor.
  - Pressing `Escape` in the editor (`PasteTextBox`) or when focused on `FindBar` buttons (`Aa`, prev/next, chevron) did not close the Find bar; `Tab` / `Shift+Tab` did not jump cleanly between `FindTextBox` and `ReplaceTextBox`; collapsing the Replace row while `ReplaceTextBox` had focus stranded focus on a collapsed control.

  - A single-tab `SelectorBar` (`SourceSelector` with only `FileTab`) remained at the top of the Source card after the old Paste tab was retired, wasting ~44 px of vertical space and cramping the `Automation` expander at the bottom.
  - The `Drop a document here` card had a plain solid border with no hover/press/drag-over state and only opened the file picker if you clicked the small `Browse files` button inside it. In addition, `OnDropZonePointerPressed` did not filter out non-left mouse clicks, and `OnSourceDragOver`/`OnSourceDrop`/`OnEditorDragOver`/`OnEditorDrop` did not set `e.Handled = true` (bubbling up to `RootGrid`'s window drag/drop handlers).
  - `PinFileButton` stayed enabled even when no file was selected (`HasInputFile == false`) and kept a static `"Pin/unpin..."` tooltip and accessible name instead of reflecting whether a file was loaded or already pinned.
  - `InputFileTextBox` (`Selected file`) updated `ViewModel.InputFilePath` only on `LostFocus`, so typing or pasting a valid path (or `"C:\path\file.md"` from Explorer's *Copy as path*) left `PinFileButton.IsEnabled == false` while focused; furthermore, `MainViewModel.OnInputFilePathChanged` called `Path.GetFullPath(value)` without a `try/catch`, throwing `ArgumentException` on quotes or invalid path characters.
  - `ScanningLabel` was plain muted text with no activity indicator (`ProgressRing`).
- **Focused `NumberBox` showed a `TextBox` clear (`×`) button & leaked duplicate event handlers:**
  - WinUI 3's `NumberBox` embeds a `TextBox` (`InputBox`) whose template reveals `DeleteButton` (`×`) in the `ButtonVisible` visual state on focus. Also, `HoverPolish.Apply` needed `AttachedProperty` idempotency on `NumberBox` so the 300 ms layout tracker did not attach duplicate `Loaded`/`GotFocus` handlers on every layout pass, and `AutomationProperties.SetAccessibilityView(button, AccessibilityView.Raw)` so the suppressed `DeleteButton` is hidden from UIAutomation/Narrator.
- **Right-edge flyouts clipped outside non-maximised windows:**
  - `OutlineButton` and `MoreMenuButton` (plus its attached `Recent exports` flyout) used `Placement="Bottom"` (center-aligned), extending past the right edge of the window.
- **`StatusMsgText` UIA `Name` stayed stuck on `"Ready."`:**
  - WinUI 3's `TextBlockAutomationPeer` caches its initial `AutomationProperties.Name` (`"Ready."`) unless `AutomationProperties.SetName(StatusMsgText, ViewModel.StatusText)` is updated when `StatusText` changes.
- **Undo/Redo preview & burst sync (`ApplyUndoSnapshot`, `InsertBlock`, `ApplyLineEdit`):**

Also I don't want it faster. While it was trying to speed through the animation it lagged the computer hard! And the window color doesn't match the main window."`)
- **Agents Used:** `2 agents total` (`1 Parent Orchestrator` [`c0aca02f-aa6f-4116-a8bb-561b5a625c1b`] + `1 Coding Worker Subagent` [`e135a49d-7881-421d-863e-cc092e3da77e`], running `Gemini 3.8 Flash (High)`; plus reconciled interrupted Run #77 Worker [`f5249f11-7996-43c0-b445-4278eec53b62`])

**Root causes identified & fixed for the 4 OCR Experience Overlay issues:**
1. **Repeat-run ~1s flash-away (`_playbackTask` stale reference + `SynchronizationContext.Post` race + `PluginFileReader.Cache`):**
   - `OcrExperienceOverlay.FadeOutAndCloseAsync()` and `PageStarted()` never reset `_playbackTask = null` when an import finished. On the 2nd import, `PageRead()` enqueued `StartPlaybackIfNeededOnUi` asynchronously via `_dispatcher.TryEnqueue(...)`, while `FinishAndFadeToEditorAsync()` checked `lock (_sync) playback = _playbackTask;` before that callback ran, saw Run #1's already-completed `Task`, skipped Stages 1–4, showed the final banner for 520ms, and closed the overlay after <1s.
   - `MainViewModel.ReadInputFileAsync` used `syncContext.Post(_ => Apply(), null)` even when already on the UI thread, so when `PluginFileReader.ImportAsync` completed fast, `await ViewModel.LastFileReadTask` returned in `MainWindow.OpenOrImportDocumentAsync` *before* `Apply()` populated `ViewModel.CurrentMarkdown` and `ViewModel.SourceImportKind`.
   - `PluginFileReader.ImportAsync` cached converted documents by `(path, timestamp, length)`, so re-opening the same scanned PDF skipped `ReverseImportService` and never emitted real PDF page previews on repeat opens.
   - `MainWindow.OpenOrImportDocumentAsync` set `ViewModel.InputFilePath = path` directly, which was a no-op in `CommunityToolkit.Mvvm` when re-opening the exact same file path twice in a row.
2. **Inconsistent & overly fast animation pacing across document sizes:**
   - Stage 2, 3, and 4 durations in `OcrExperienceOverlay` previously varied with `trace.Blocks.Count` and `trace.Words.Count` (`Math.Clamp(blockCount, 1, 14)` and `Math.Clamp(totalWords / 8, 6, 36)`), making short documents finish in ~3.0s while larger ones took ~4.8s, and racing through stages too fast to read.
   - Introduced deterministic, content-invariant `OcrPlaybackSchedule.ForPage(blockCount, wordCount, pageIndex, pageCount, stage1ElapsedMs)` in `MarkSmith.Core/Ocr/OcrTrace.cs`, guaranteeing an exact **~7,280 ms (~7.3s)** single-page animation (`Stage 1 = 1,150 ms`, `Stage 2 = 1,600 ms`, `Stage 3 = 1,600 ms`, `Stage 4 = 1,800 ms`, `Final Sheet Hold = 950 ms`, `Fade-Out = 180 ms`) regardless of whether a page has 0, 1, 6, or 42 blocks or 0, 2, or 1,250 words.
3. **Severe UI / computer lag during playback:**
   - `OcrExperienceOverlay.xaml` had `<ThemeShadow />` with `Translation="0,0,64"` and a `ScaleTransform` on `TheaterCard` over the live `WebView2` preview, forcing DWM 3D shadow re-projection on every child layout invalidation.
   - `MainWindow._previewDebounce` fired while `OcrExperiencePopup` was open, causing `WebView2` to compile and render HTML/Mermaid in the background right as the overlay animated.
   - Stage 3 allocated up to 320 `Border` controls with `CornerRadius` and new `SolidColorBrush` instances inside a `16ms` (60fps) loop, mutating all previous borders every tick; Stage 4 called synchronous `MarkdownScrollViewer.UpdateLayout()` on every block step and used `EntranceThemeTransition` on dynamic cards; `LaserBeam` mutated `Canvas.SetTop` (invalidating `Canvas` arrange) instead of `RenderTransform` (`LaserTransform.Y`).
   - `OcrVisualElements.SampleBitmapToGrid` and `CountDistinctColors` made ~409,600 per-pixel `SKBitmap.GetPixel(x, y)` P/Invoke calls per page instead of reading `page.Pixels` in bulk, and `OcrTrace.EncodePreviewPng` encoded up to `1600px` PNGs with redundant `SKBitmap` copies.
4. **Window/card colour mismatch with `MainWindow`:**
   - Replaced all hardcoded deep navy-blue (`#070B14`, `#0F172A`, `#0B1120`, `#1E293B`) and neon cyan (`#38BDF8`) brushes in `OcrExperienceOverlay.xaml` and `OcrExperienceOverlay.xaml.cs` with `MainWindow`'s native WinUI 3 `{ThemeResource ApplicationPageBackgroundThemeBrush}`, `{ThemeResource CardBackgroundFillColorDefaultBrush}`, `{ThemeResource CardBackgroundFillColorSecondaryBrush}`, `{ThemeResource LayerFillColorAltBrush}`, `{ThemeResource CardStrokeColorDefaultBrush}`, `{StaticResource PipelineCardStyle}`, MarkSmith `#1A8CFF` brand accent, and `<Image Source="ms-appx:///Assets/logo.png" />` in the header.
5. **Reconciled interrupted Run #77 changes (`MermaidDiagramStudio` & `SmartArtDesignStudio`):**
   - Completed keyboard accelerators (`F2` rename, `Ctrl+F` find shapes, `Ctrl+Enter` sync to document, `Shift+F10` / `Application` context menu) and UIA status announcements across `MermaidDiagramStudioWindow`, `MermaidDiagramStudioControl`, `NodePaletteControl`, and `SmartArtDesignStudioWindow`.

**Shipped:**

  - Added `OcrPlaybackSchedule` and `OcrPlaybackSchedule.ForPage(...)` for content-invariant ~7.3s single-page and ~3.8s follow-up multi-page schedules.
  - Lowered `PreviewMaxEdge` from `1600` to `1100`, avoided redundant `OcrGeometry.Resize` when already within bounds, and switched `SampleBitmapToGrid` / `CountDistinctColors` to bulk `page.Pixels` array reads.

**Found:**
- **OCR & Document Import Experience Overlay (`OcrExperienceOverlay`, `PdfMarkdownImporter`, `MainWindow`):**
  - **Header telemetry pill clipping at 1220×800:** Live `PrintWindow` inspection showed that `OcrExperienceOverlay.xaml` Row 0 used `ColumnDefinitions="Auto,*,Auto"`, allowing the 560px unconstrained `SubtitleText` in `Column="0"` (`Auto`) to starve `Column="1"` (`*`) and clip the left edge of the `Elements` pill (`Elements 3` rendered as `3`).
  - **Stale center transfer bridge across consecutive imports:** `PulseCenterBridge` colored `BridgePulseBorder`, `BridgeIcon`, and `BridgeBlockText` (`#5 → .md`) during Stage 4, and `ClearCanvasOverlays()` never reset them, so Stage 1–3 of a 2nd consecutive import displayed the previous import's `#5 → .md` green badge.
  - **First-run Welcome Tour collision with CLI document import:** Launching `Marksmith.exe <file>` on a fresh profile triggered `OnFirstRunLoaded` (`ShowWelcomeTourAsync`) immediately over the active `OcrExperienceOverlay` 4-stage visual breakdown.
  - **Multi-page scanned PDF playback duration & `PdfMarkdownImporter` exception safety:** A 10+ page scanned PDF animated all 4 stages for every page sequentially (~40s+), and if `engine.RecognizeAsync` or `OcrVisualElements.ExtractPage` threw after `OcrTrace.NotifyStarted`, `OcrTrace.NotifyRead` was not called, stalling `RunPlaybackLoopAsync` for up to 5 seconds.
  - **Deferred layout geometry for cut lines & scan laser:** When `OcrExperienceOverlay` transitioned from `Visibility.Collapsed` to `Visible`, `PageViewportGrid.ActualWidth/Height` could still be `0` during initial Stage 1/2 setup; `_positionedOverlays` were re-projected in `FitPageSheet()` on `SizeChanged`, but `_cutLines` and `_lastLaserNormY` were not.
  - **Bypassed `OpenOrImportDocumentAsync` entry points:** Entering/pasting a path into `InputFileTextBox`, picking a file from `MarkdownFilesComboBox` (`OnMarkdownFileSelected`), selecting `"Open recent: ..."` in the Command Palette, or opening a non-Markdown document from Document Galaxy (`OpenDocumentRequested`) set `ViewModel.InputFilePath` directly instead of routing through `OpenOrImportDocumentAsync`; spreadsheet imports (`OnImportDocumentClick` and `OnInsertSpreadsheetClick`) did not call `OcrExperiencePopup.BeginImportSession()` before `PlayImportExperienceAndFadeToEditorAsync`.
- **Version History (`HistoryWindow` & `HistoryWindowViewModel`):**
  - **Orphaned selection across filters:** When `SearchQuery` or `IsStarredOnlyFilter` hid the currently selected version, `ApplyTimelineFilter()` kept the hidden version selected in the diff/preview pane instead of auto-selecting the first visible version (`Bands[0].Items[0]`) or clearing `Selected` when `FilterHidesAll` was true.
  - **Keyboard navigation & shortcuts:** `TimelineScroll` (`ScrollViewer`) swallowed `Up`/`Down`/`Home`/`End` keys instead of stepping through visible versions; `HistoryWindow` lacked `Ctrl+Enter` (Restore), `Ctrl+1`/`2`/`3` (Unified / Side-by-side / Preview view toggles), `Ctrl+C` (Copy version Markdown), `Ctrl+Shift+C` (Copy unified diff patch), `S` (Toggle star), and `Shift+F10` / `Application` context menu invocation; `OnRootKeyDown` lacked a `_dialogOpen` guard while Rename or Checkpoint `ContentDialog`s were open.
  - **Pane 1 document list context menu & single-line dialog `Enter` submission:** Document rows in Pane 1 had no right-click context menu (`Open in editor`, `Take checkpoint…`, `Show in File Explorer`, `Copy file path`), and the single-line `TextBox` in `RenameAsync` and `OnTakeSnapshotClick` (plus `OnSavePresetClick` and `OnCreateThemeClick` in `MainWindow`) did not submit on `Enter`.
  - **Skeptical Reviewer follow-up findings in `HistoryWindowViewModel` & `HistoryWindow`:**
    - `CopyDiffPatch` called synchronous `BuildUnifiedDiffPatch()` immediately after `SelectVersionCommand.Execute(item)`, racing against `RefreshDiffAsync` and copying the previously selected version's `UnifiedDiffRows` when right-clicking an unselected row or pressing `Ctrl+Shift+C` before `RefreshDiffAsync` completed; `BuildUnifiedDiffPatch` also called parameterless `.TrimEnd()` instead of `.TrimEnd('\r', '\n')`, stripping trailing Markdown hard-break spaces on the final line.
    - When `ApplyTimelineFilter()` cleared selection (`Selected = null`), `DiffRows`/`UnifiedDiffRows`/`SelectedHeader`/`DiffStats` were not cleared, `ShowUnifiedRows`/`ShowSplitRows` did not check `Selected is not null`, and in `Preview` mode `ShowDiffPlaceholder` (`Selected is null && !ShowPreview`) remained false while `PreviewWeb` stayed visible showing the previous version's HTML.
    - `ClearFilters()` and `TakeSnapshotAsync()` mutated `IsStarredOnlyFilter` and `SearchQuery` sequentially without `_suppressFilter`, triggering redundant intermediate filter passes; `RenameVersionAsync()` did not re-apply `ApplyTimelineFilter()` when `SearchQuery` was active; `DeleteVersionAsync()` did not refresh `Selected`'s diff when an unselected predecessor version was deleted, jumped to index 0 when deleting a middle selected version instead of selecting the adjacent visible version, and `RefreshSelectedFileCount()` did not update `Summary.LastModified` / `LatestSource` when the newest version was deleted.

### 2026-10-12 (Fix: Harden PDF & Document Import Against Stowed Dispatch Exceptions and Stride Errors)

**Incident Investigation:**
- Following the introduction of `OcrInspectionStudioWindow`, user reported a fatal crash when importing a Service Agreement document (`00P7F000006aiR2UAI_Groom, J ELPE service agreement.pdf`).
- Windows Event Log confirmed process termination with exception `0xc000027b` (`STATUS_FAIL_FAST_EXCEPTION`) originating from `CoreMessagingXP.dll` (`RoFailFastWithErrorContext`).
- Crash dump analysis (`Marksmith.exe.22148.dmp`) revealed a stowed exception `0x80004003` (`E_POINTER` / `NullReferenceException`) on UI thread `0x513C` while worker thread `0x5010` was executing `OcrGeometry.ToGray` / `MarkSmithOcrProvider.Recognize`.
- **Root causes identified:**
  1. **Thread Access Violation:** Background worker thread invoked `OcrInspectionStudioWindow.PageRead`, which directly accessed WinUI UI property `EngineBadgeText.Text`.
  2. **Theme Resource Lookup Failure (`0x80004003`):** `OcrInspectionStudioWindow.xaml.cs` used `(Brush)Application.Current.Resources["..."]` to look up theme brushes (`SystemFillColorSuccessBrush`, `SubtleFillColorSecondaryBrush`, `TextFillColorSecondaryBrush`, etc.). In WinUI 3, theme brushes live in `ThemeDictionaries`; direct key indexing causes `IMap.Lookup` failure projected as `E_POINTER`.
  3. **Unhandled Async Dispatch Exception:** Unhandled exceptions inside `DispatcherQueue.TryEnqueue` lambdas escaped directly into the CoreMessagingXP message loop, triggering unhandled fail-fast (`0xc000027b`).
  4. **Bitmap Stride Mismatch in `OcrGeometry.ToGray`:** Stride was assumed to equal `width * 4`, failing to respect `bmp.RowBytes` row alignment on native-rendered or odd-dimensioned bitmaps.
  5. **Missing Non-Fatal Error Resilience:** Rendering or decoding errors on individual pages were not caught gracefully, halting the entire import pipeline.

**Shipped:**
- `MarkSmith.Core/Ocr/OcrGeometry.cs`:
  - Rewrote `ToGray` to be row-stride aware using `bmp.RowBytes` with explicit span bounds checking.
  - Auto-converts non-Bgra8888 bitmaps safely before luminance calculation.
- `MarkSmith.Core/Ocr/OcrTrace.cs`:
  - Made `Preview(...)` null-safe for `SKImage.FromBitmap` and `.Encode()`.
  - Added `PageFailed(int pageNumber, string errorMessage)` to `IOcrObserver` and implemented `OcrTrace.NotifyFailed`.
- `MarkSmith.Core/Services/Import/PdfMarkdownImporter.cs`:
  - Wrapped page iteration, text extraction, digital preview rendering, and OCR execution in defensive `try/catch` blocks.
  - Forwarded page failure notifications to `options.OcrObserver`.
  - Replaced obsolete `Page.ExperimentalAccess.Paths` with `Page.Paths`.
- `MarkSmith.Desktop/Services/WindowsPdfRenderer.cs`:
  - Added dimension clamping (`maxDimension = 3600`) and safe color-type conversion to avoid native memory exhaustion and stride bugs.
- `MarkSmith.Desktop/Views/Ocr/OcrInspectionStudioWindow.xaml.cs`:
  - Converted `_pagePreviews` to a thread-safe `ConcurrentDictionary`.
  - Introduced thread-safe `_currentEngineName` so background worker threads never touch `EngineBadgeText.Text`.
  - Wrapped all `DispatcherQueue.TryEnqueue` callbacks in `try/catch` to guarantee exceptions never escape into `CoreMessagingXP.dll`.
  - Replaced all direct `Application.Current.Resources[...]` lookups with safe `ThemeBrush.Get(key, RootGrid.ActualTheme)`.
  - Implemented `ReportPageError(int pageNumber, string errorMessage)` to surface non-fatal warnings in the studio status banner without closing the window.
- `MarkSmith.Desktop/MainWindow.xaml.cs`:
  - Wrapped PDF and document import in guaranteed cleanup (`studio.Close()`, `WindowsPdfRenderer.Release()`).
  - Added `PageFailed` forwarding and wrapped `TryEnqueue` callbacks in `AmbientStudioOcrObserver`.
- `MarkSmith.Desktop/Views/InsertDialogControls.cs`:
  - Replaced `Application.Current.Resources[...]` brush indexing with `ThemeBrush.For`.
- `MarkSmith.Tests/Ocr/PdfImportTests.cs`:
  - Added test verifying target Service Agreement PDF parses safely without throwing.
  - Added test verifying `OcrGeometry.ToGray` handles non-standard strides, 1x1 dimensions, and color formats.
  - Added test verifying `IOcrObserver.PageFailed` notification dispatch.

**Verified:**

- `dotnet build MarkSmith.Tests/MarkSmith.Tests.csproj`: **0 errors**.

### 2026-10-14 (Document Import Crash Resolution, OCR Studio XAML Hardening & Vector Fusion Scaling)

- **Timestamp:** 2026-10-14T22:02:00Z
- **Model:** `Gemini 3.8 Flash (High)`
- **Identity:** `Antigravity AI Agent (Google DeepMind)`
- **Mode:** `/boost` Delegation Routine
- **Trigger:** Document / PDF import crash report investigation & standalone OCR studio hardening mandate

**Root Causes & Findings:**
1. **XAML Initialization Re-entrancy (`0xc000027b`):** In `OcrInspectionStudioWindow.xaml`, setting `SelectedIndex="0"` alongside `SelectionChanged="OnMarkdownScopeChanged"` on `MarkdownScopeComboBox` caused events to fire during `InitializeComponent()` before `MarkdownPreviewTextBox` was instantiated, throwing stowed WinRT exceptions directly into CoreMessagingXP.
2. **Missing CodePages Provider for Legacy Imports:** Decoding legacy code pages (e.g. Windows-1252 in RTF bodies of `.msg` files, older document encodings) in .NET 8 threw `NotSupportedException` unless `CodePagesEncodingProvider.Instance` was explicitly registered.
3. **Unguarded CLI Launch & Import Paths:** CLI document launches in `App.xaml.cs` ran unobserved async tasks; spreadsheet and plugin import error paths lacked fallback catches to status notifications.
4. **Studio Canvas & List Overhead:** Generating tens of thousands of vector shape canvas items during image vector fusion caused WinUI UI layout hangs; inspector needed a listed item cap (`ListedShapesCap = 1000`) and contour line sampling to stay responsive.
5. **Host Google Drive Test Contamination:** `CloudStorageService` checked physical drive `G:\My Drive` directly, causing mock environment unit tests to fail on machines with real mounted Google Drive volumes.

**Shipped:**
- `MarkSmith.Desktop/Views/Ocr/OcrInspectionStudioWindow.xaml` & `OcrInspectionStudioWindow.xaml.cs`:
  - Removed XAML-time `SelectedIndex="0"` from `MarkdownScopeComboBox` to prevent early re-entrant event dispatch during `InitializeComponent()`.
  - Added defensive null-guards across all UI elements (`MarkdownPreviewTextBox`, `StatusBannerIcon`, `StatusBannerText`, `LaserBeam`, `PrevPageButton`, `NextPageButton`, `QuickReclassifyComboBox`).
  - Retained paper-white background (`#FFFFFF`) with genuine document sheet canvas, element bounding boxes, and sweeping scan laser.
- `MarkSmith.Desktop/App.xaml.cs` & `Program.cs`:
  - Registered `CodePagesEncodingProvider.Instance` at program entry and in `MsgImporter`.
  - Dispatched CLI file launches via `window.DispatcherQueue.TryEnqueue` wrapped in comprehensive try/catch with UI status error reporting.
  - Set `e.Handled = true` in `App.UnhandledException` to log and prevent fail-fast termination.
- `MarkSmith.Desktop/MainWindow.xaml.cs`:
  - Audited and guarded all document import paths (`OpenOrImportDocumentAsync`, `ImportScannedImageToEditorAsync`, `OnInsertSpreadsheetClick`, `OnSourceDrop`, `OnWindowDrop`, `OnEditorDrop`, `OnBrowseFileClick`, `OnMarkdownFileSelected`) with non-fatal status notifications.
- `MarkSmith.Desktop/Services/NativeFilePicker.cs`:
  - Added warning banner if native shell dialog takes over 8 seconds due to cloud folder / shell extension stalls.
- `MarkSmith.Core/Composer/ImageShapeComposer.cs` & `ViewModels/ShapeStudio/ShapeDesignStudioViewModel.cs`:
  - Added `ListedShapesCap = 1000` to keep inspector UI snappy while canvas and export render the full set.
  - Enforced a 12,000 element practical fusion budget with evenly sampled contour lines.
- `MarkSmith.Core/Services/CloudStorageService.cs`:
  - Added `_isCustomEnv` check to prevent probing host `G:\My Drive` volume during test runs.

### 2026-10-14 (Document Import Crash Elimination, OCR Studio Review Mode & Concurrency Polish)

- **Timestamp:** 2026-10-14T23:14:00Z
- **Model:** `Gemini 3.8 Flash (High)`
- **Identity:** `Antigravity AI Agent (Google DeepMind)`
- **Mode:** `/boost` Delegation Routine
- **Trigger:** Document / PDF import crash report investigation, OCR studio completion race condition fix & interactive element reclassification polish

**Bugs Identified & Fixed:**
1. **Studio Queue Drain vs Completion Race Condition:** In `OcrInspectionStudioWindow.xaml.cs`, `CompleteScanning()` immediately scheduled review mode transition while `ProcessPageQueueAsync` was still actively draining animations for earlier pages. When `ProcessPageQueueAsync` finished its loop, it checked `if (_session.Pages.Count >= _expectedPageCount && !_isReviewMode)` which was bypassed because `_isReviewMode` had already been flipped to `true`, leaving the visual canvas and inspector cards in a desynchronized half-scanned state.
   - *Fix:* Added `_scanningCompleted` coordination flag. `ProcessPageQueueAsync` now drains all queued pages and transitions cleanly into review mode; `CompleteScanning()` only enters review mode immediately if the queue is already empty and idle.
2. **Element Reclassification State Desynchronization:** In `OcrInspectionStudioWindow.xaml.cs`, `ReclassifyElement` updated the canvas frame and preview text, but left the middle panel card header (`titleText.Text = $"#{elem.Id} · {elem.KindDisplayName}"`), the card's combobox, the card's snippet text, `SelectedElementBadgeText`, and `QuickReclassifyComboBox` displaying stale kinds and colors.
   - *Fix:* Directly synchronized the inspector card, selection badge, and quick-reclassify combobox inside `ReclassifyElement`.
3. **Missing Editor Synchronization on Interactive Menu Imports:** In `MainWindow.xaml.cs` (`ImportDocumentInteractiveAsync`), all four import branches (Spreadsheet direct, Spreadsheet fallback, PDF/DOCX, and Plugin file reader) updated `ViewModel.PastedMarkdown` and set `ViewModel.UsePasteSource = true`, but NEVER called `SyncEditorFromDocument()`, leaving the UI editor displaying previous document content until manually nudged. Additionally, in the PDF branch of `ImportDocumentInteractiveAsync`, `else { studio.CompleteScanning(); }` was omitted, causing PDFs with scanned pages to stall in scanning mode indefinitely.
   - *Fix:* Added `studio.CompleteScanning()` and called `SyncEditorFromDocument()` across all interactive import pathways.
4. **File Sharing Violations on Open/Synced Documents:** Default `File.OpenRead` uses `FileShare.Read`, which throws an `IOException` if a document is concurrently held open by Word, Excel, or OneDrive file synchronization.
   - *Fix:* Replaced `File.OpenRead` with `new FileStream(..., FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.ReadWrite)` in `ReverseImportService.cs`, `MsgImporter.cs`, and `MainWindow.xaml.cs` (for spreadsheets and WebView2 image serving). Wrapped file stream opens in `ReverseImportService.ConvertDocxToMarkdown`, `ImportFromDocxAsync`, `ImportFromDocx`, and `ImportFromPdf` in try/catch blocks returning safe `ReverseImportResult("", ImportTier.None, false, warning, Array.Empty<string>())` instead of throwing unhandled exceptions.
5. **Empty & Corrupted Document Fallback Handling:** If a PDF or document had 0 pages or empty content, the inspection studio window was opened and left blank indefinitely.
   - *Fix:* In `OpenOrImportDocumentAsync`, if extracted markdown is empty, the studio is cleanly closed and an informative warning status banner is displayed on the main editor window.

**Shipped:**
- `MarkSmith.Core/Services/ReverseImportService.cs`:
  - Added non-blocking `FileShare.ReadWrite` and defensive exception guards returning safe failure results across all DOCX and PDF import methods.
- `MarkSmith.Desktop/MainWindow.xaml.cs`:
  - Added `SyncEditorFromDocument()` across all interactive import branches.
  - Added `studio.CompleteScanning()` to PDF interactive import.
  - Handled empty document extractions gracefully with status warnings instead of lingering blank studio windows.
  - Replaced `File.OpenRead` with `FileShare.ReadWrite` streams in spreadsheet imports and WebView2 image host mapping.
- `MarkSmith.Desktop/Views/Ocr/OcrInspectionStudioWindow.xaml.cs`:
  - Added `_scanningCompleted` coordination to eliminate race conditions between queue processing and scan completion.
  - Synchronized inspector cards, selection badges, and quick-reclassify dropdowns during element reclassification.
- `MarkSmith.Tests/Ocr/OcrInspectionStudioTests.cs`:

### 2026-10-15 (Shape Rendering Optimizations & Deferred Mosaic Synthesis)

- **Timestamp:** 2026-10-15T00:15:00Z
- **Model:** `Gemini 3.8 Flash (High)`
- **Identity:** `Antigravity AI Agent (Google DeepMind)`
- **Mode:** `/boost`
- **Trigger:** Implementation of all four Shape Rendering Optimizations (Tricks 1-4) across in-app preview and Word (.docx) export

**Optimizations Implemented:**
1. **Trick 1: Skia Flattened Bitmap Preview (`shapes.Count > 150`):**
   - In `ShapeMarkdownHtml.cs`, when shape count exceeds 150, shapes are rasterized offscreen into an in-memory `SKBitmap` via `ImageShapeComposer.RenderBitmapPreviewPng` and emitted as an `<img src="data:image/png;base64,...">` tag.
   - Reduces DOM element count from hundreds/thousands of individual `<path>`/`<rect>` nodes down to an $O(1)$ single `<img>` tag, completely eliminating WebView2 layout thrashing and scrolling stutter.
2. **Trick 3: Compound Path Grouping by Color (`31..150` shapes):**
   - In `ImageShapeComposer.RenderSvgCompound`, shapes sharing the same palette fill color are grouped into a single `<path d="M... Z M... Z" fill="#HEX"/>`.
   - Collapses DOM node count by ~95% while retaining native SVG vector sharpness at arbitrary DPI and zoom levels.
3. **Trick 4: LOD Clamping for In-App Preview (`MaxPreviewGrid = 32`):**
   - In `MosaicRecipe.cs`, `Synthesize(isPreview: true)` clamps dense grids to `MaxPreviewGrid = 32`. In-app editing stays fluid and responsive even if a recipe requests grid 64, 96, or 128.
4. **Trick 2: Deferred Recipe Synthesis & 100% Native Word Export:**
   - Word exports via `DocxExportService.cs` (`RenderMosaic` and `RenderShapes`) call `recipe.Synthesize(isPreview: false)` to synthesize the full requested density.
   - Generates 100% native DrawingML vector shapes (`<wps:wsp>` within `<wpg:wgp>`, with `<a:prstGeom>` and `<a:solidFill>`), ensuring every individual tile is fully vector-scalable and editable inside Microsoft Word. Validates against OpenXML schema with 0 errors.
5. **Fixed Parity Cancellation Bug in `ResolveShape`:**
   - Identified that the legacy positional formula `(x * 3 + y * 7 + (x ^ y))` evaluates to an identically even integer for all integer coordinates $(x, y)$, causing palettes with an even number of shapes (such as 2-shape palettes) to evaluate to index 0 for 100% of cells.
   - Added parity offset `(x + y) & 1` when `shapes.Count` is even to produce proper checkerboard/interleaved distribution.
6. **Attributes Support in `MosaicRecipe.Parse`:**
   - Added `IDictionary<string, string>? attributes` to `MosaicRecipe.Parse`, allowing `node.Attributes` from `AdvancedFeaturePipeline` to populate recipe parameters.

**Shipped:**
- `MarkSmith.Core/Composer/MosaicRecipe.cs`:
  - Created deferred mosaic/shape recipe parser and synthesizer with preview LOD clamping.
- `MarkSmith.Core/Composer/ImageShapeComposer.cs`:
  - Added `RenderBitmapPreviewPngBytes`, `RenderBitmapPreviewPng`, and `RenderSvgCompound`.
  - Fixed parity cancellation in `ResolveShape` for even shape counts.
- `MarkSmith.Core/Composer/ShapeMarkdownHtml.cs`:
  - Updated `LiftShapes` to support `:::mosaic` and shape recipes with 3-tier rendering (bitmap preview, compound path SVG, discrete SVG).
- `MarkSmith.Core/AdvancedFeatures/Detectors.cs` & `AdvancedFeaturePipeline.cs`:
  - Added and registered `MosaicDetector`.
- `MarkSmith.Core/Services/DocxExportService.cs`:
  - Added `RenderMosaic` and updated `RenderShapes` for full-density deferred recipe synthesis to native DrawingML.
- `MarkSmith.Tests/ComposerOptimizationTests.cs`:
  - Added tests for all 4 optimizations and recipe parsing in both `:::mosaic` and `:::shapes` blocks.

2. **Picture & Coat-of-Arms Extraction + Relative `_media` Preview/Export Resolution (`OcrVisualElements.cs`, `MainViewModel.cs`, `MainWindow.xaml.cs`, `DocumentImages.cs`):**
   - Updated `OcrVisualElements.DetectPictures` to mask only genuine text words (allowing non-text graphic/crest clusters with garbage OCR tokens like `(D`, `gbQ`, `J`, `ff'` to remain intact in the foreground mask and get claimed/suppressed when enclosed by a detected picture), detect monochrome/grayscale crests/logos, and save extracted `.png` files (`![Picture from page N](...)`) whenever `!PreferShapeMosaicForPictures && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(MediaDirectory)`.
   - Preserved `textBlocks` column reading order when inserting `visualBlocks` in `OcrVisualElements.ExtractPage` instead of globally re-sorting all blocks by `Bounds.Top`, keeping 2-column reading order intact even on pages with extracted pictures or diagrams.

   - Extended `MainViewModel.DetachFromOpenFile(string? importedDocumentFolder = null)` and `MainWindow.BuildPreviewCanvasHtml` (`DocumentImages.InlineLocalImages`) so relative `*_media/...` links resolve in live preview and Word/PDF exports after PDF import.
3. **Cross-Platform Vector-Path PDF Page Rendering Fallback & 1-Bit/8-Bit Stream Decoding (`PdfMarkdownImporter.cs`):**
   - Added `RenderVectorPageFallback(Page page)` using `SkiaSharp` `SKPath` at 180 DPI so vector-outlined PDFs (`page.Paths.Count > 200` with 0 embedded images and 0 font text, such as `form.pdf`) render and OCR cleanly even when `options.RenderPage` (`WindowsPdfRenderer`) is not supplied.
   - Updated `Decode(IPdfImage)` to use `img.TryGetBytesAsMemory` for 1-bit and 8-bit raw stream images.
4. **Multi-Column & Sidebar Reading Order Segmentation (`MsSegmenter.cs` & `OcrLayout.cs`):**
   - Added 1D vertical barcode cluster filtering (`IsVerticalBarcodeCluster`) and thin horizontal/vertical border line stripping (`IsThinRule`) before recursive XY-cut layout segmentation.
   - Added single and simultaneous top-header + bottom-footer horizontal cut detection (`TryFindDualHorizontalCutForVerticalSplit`) in `MsSegmenter.SplitRecursive` and `OcrLayout.SplitRecursive` so full-width header and footer banners are separated first, exposing clean 2-column vertical cuts.
   - Prioritized horizontal cuts on narrow left-sidebar layouts (`< 25%` page width) so sidebar section titles stay paired with their right-hand paragraphs, guarded narrow margin question numbers (`13`) against vertical splitting, and joined interleaved same-line letter fragments.
5. **Word Spacing, Look-Alike Normalization & Recursive DP Joined-Word Splitting (`MsRecognizer.cs` & `MsLexicon.cs`):**
   - Filtered wide tab/column outlier gaps (`> 1.15f`) before Otsu thresholding in `MsRecognizer.SpaceThreshold` and clamped the upper space threshold to `0.46f`.
   - Expanded `MsLexicon` with government/form vocabulary, `ii`/`ll`/`it`/`rt` confusion pairs (`paitner` -> `partner`, `suppoit` -> `support`, `wiii` -> `will`), internal `I`/`1`/`|` -> `l` normalization (`toId` -> `told`, `Iive` -> `live`), and recursive multi-word dynamic programming segmentation (`TryDpSplit`) to split 2–6+ concatenated words (`Carerpayment` -> `Carer payment`, `Disabilitysupportpension` -> `Disability support pension`, `YouthAiiowance` -> `Youth Allowance`, `natureofcommitment` -> `nature of commitment`, `HaveyoutoIdusaboutyourseparation` -> `Have you told us about your separation`).
6. **Clean Markdown Reconstruction & Multi-Column Table Extraction (`OcrMarkdown.cs`):**
   - Added checkbox/arrow artifact cleanup (`|g`, `[g`, `[0`, `|0`, `[9`, `Z)`, `|iZ)`, `|iX)`, `@i5V`, `[T`, `[X` -> `- [ ]` / `- [x]` or stripped), 1D barcode and empty comb-box line filtering (`l||||l||l||...`, `[i~ [iE`, `[iE`, `iii]`, `---l`), median alphabetic word-height calculation per line so tall noise glyphs don't promote body lines into `# H1` headings, sentence-initial `ls`/`lt`/`lf` -> `Is`/`It`/`If` repair, and multi-column aligned table reconstruction (`OcrBlockKind.Table`).

### Standing rules for every future run (read before writing a blueprint)

1. **No new Audit/Score/Analyze items. Ever.** If a blueprint idea's deliverable is "Add
   `AuditX(...)` and `FormatXSummary(...)`", it is a feature, not polish: drop it.
2. Polish means an existing control looks, moves and responds better: hover/press/focus states,
   spacing, alignment, empty/loading/error states, keyboard paths, copy, consistent icons, dark/light
   and high-contrast correctness. Verify by launching and looking (gx.ps1/mouse.ps1 rigs from runs
   #68-#70), not by grepping XAML for an x:Name.
3. Run the **whole** test project, not a filter, and report the real count.
4. Leave the "6 surfaces × 1 idea" template behind; pick one or two surfaces and finish them.
